positions.name: DbMigrationDecision
positions.frame: what are the parameters and justifications of the database migration from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB for the analytics pipeline?
positions.why: src-1 asserts the migration decision with its performance and cost justification; src-2 through src-4 decompose that same decision into migration target, performance gain, and timeline. All four cohere under one directional read of the decision's scope and rationale — the assertion and its structured restatement.
